# Kreathief

> AI-powered browser-based design platform combining image generation, editable vector tools, real-time collaboration, and export workflows.

## Product
- Homepage: https://www.kreathief.com/
- Features: https://www.kreathief.com/#features
- Pricing: https://www.kreathief.com/#pricing
- Blog: https://www.kreathief.com/blog
- Help Center: https://www.kreathief.com/help
- API: https://www.kreathief.com/api

## About
Kreathief helps designers, marketers, agencies, and creative teams create production-ready visual work in one browser-based workflow. It supports AI image generation, vector editing, mockups, collaboration, templates, and professional exports.
